descriptionHtml:
ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5060 Ti OC Edition 16GB GDDR7 Graphics Card

Elevate your PC build architecture with the ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5060 Ti OC Edition, proudly offered by Turbo Computer Egypt. Engineered perfectly for creators and competitive gamers, this next-generation GPU introduces high-speed 16GB GDDR7 memory alongside a highly efficient triple-fan cooling system. Featuring a compact layout optimized for Small Form Factor (SFF) PC compatibility, it delivers stunning ray tracing performance and AI-accelerated workflows seamlessly. Includes an official 3-year warranty across Egypt.
